description:
Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure. 
 
 Passionate about building robust solutions with global impact? Thales Mexico is looking for a Software Developer/Engineer to join a team designing, developing, and deploying cutting-edge technology solutions for the financial sector. 🚀 
 In this role, you'll lead the analysis, design, and development of software solutions, working closely with technical teams around the world, driving Thales best practices, and bringing innovative ideas that generate real business impact.
 
 🎯 What You'll Do
 Lead business requirements analysis, prototyping, design, coding, and bug fixing — always pushing for the best possible architecture and design.
 Recommend and execute new approaches to existing software development processes, ensuring technical quality and managing security vulnerabilities.
 Collaborate with global Thales teams, sharing knowledge and negotiating technical topics to ensure alignment with company best practices.
 Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and business opportunities.
 
 ✅ Must-Have
 B.S. in Computer Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or Electronic Engineering.
 Fluent Business English.
 2+ years of software development experience.
 Prior experience in the banking/financial sector.
 Strong background in Java (Spring Framework, J2EE) and Oracle PL/SQL .
 Experience with web services (SOAP/REST) and ORM frameworks (Hibernate/JPA2) .
 Comfortable working in Linux environments.
 
 ⭐ Nice-to-Have
 Exposure to CI/CD tools (Jenkins) and build tools (Maven/Ant).
 AWS cloud experience.
 
 📍 Hybrid — Office based in Cuernavaca
 
 Say HI and learn more about working at Thales (Click Here)

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
